sections.content: Functions return a value (used inside queries); stored procedures run action sequences (loops, transactions) called with CALL. Both live in the database.
They centralize logic close to data, reduce network round-trips, and enforce business rules consistently. PL/pgSQL (Postgres) and T-SQL (SQL Server) are common dialects.
Key points: functions must be deterministic for indexing, procedures can contain transactions, and version-control your DB code like app code.
